title: Red Engine 2 blueprint
description: A `*.blueprint.json`: `red_engine2 build --example`. Generated by `red_engine2 schema` from src/content/; do not edit.

scene.description: Merged into the built scene (rules, vars, ui, style, checks...).

oneOf.description: A group; `prefab_name` and `mount` are written by prefab expansion.
A prefab instance (`params` are the prefab's own: a map).

Track.description: A value that is either constant (`[0, 1, 0]`) or animated (`{"keyframes": [...]}`).

Keyframe.description: One keyframe: time in seconds, the value, an easing name (`linear` by default).

Scalar.description:
A scalar leaf: a number, or a string (an expression `"=0.56+$gap"`, a param `"$h"`, a colour), or true/false. Never an object, so an
unknown key can never hide behind it.

Scale.description: A scale: one number, `[x, y, z]`, or keyframes of either.

Keyframe2.description: One keyframe: time in seconds, the value, an easing name (`linear` by default).

Material.description: A surface: colour (`#rrggbb`, `@role`, or a track of colours), metal, roughness, glow, opacity, or a `style.materials` preset.

Track2.description: A value that is either constant (`[0, 1, 0]`) or animated (`{"keyframes": [...]}`).

Keyframe3.description: One keyframe: time in seconds, the value, an easing name (`linear` by default).

Track3.description: A value that is either constant (`[0, 1, 0]`) or animated (`{"keyframes": [...]}`).

Keyframe4.description: One keyframe: time in seconds, the value, an easing name (`linear` by default).

JointAngle.description: A joint's rotation: `[rx, ry, rz]` degrees, or one bend angle (elbows, knees).

TerrainGenerator.description: A generated terrain: a seed, a height profile and layered noise.

TerrainNoise.description: Noise layered on a terrain profile.

Opening.description: One door or window cut into a wall.

ColorOr.description: A colour string, or an object with more to say (a wall's `baseboard`, a text's `backing`).

ColorOr2.description: A colour string, or an object with more to say (a wall's `baseboard`, a text's `backing`).

vars.description: Game variables: name -> number or true/false.

player_vars.description: Per-player variables: name -> number or true/false.

phases.description: Named level states: name -> the rule ids assumed fired.

Recipe.description: What a known-good example map teaches (`recipe`).

Background.description: A screen-space sky: a gradient or a flat colour.

Camera.description: The camera (and the spawn when there are no `spawns`).

ReachCheck.description: A place the player must (or must not) reach.

SimExpect.description: What must hold at the end (or while it runs).

ScoresCheck.description: Loudness of every score the scene uses.

SoundscapeCheck.description: A soundscape run: what is heard where.

PrefabDefs.description: A scene's own prefabs: a list of definitions or an object `{name: definition}`.

params.description: name -> a default value, or a spec `{default, desc, palette}`.

ParamSpec.description:
A param: a spec (an object with `default`) or the default value itself. Deserialized by hand, as the checker reads it: an object with a
`default` key must be a strict spec (an untagged enum would fall back to "any value" and accept a misspelt key in a spec).

ParamSpecFull.description: A param with a description and an optional palette role.

Rule.description: One rule: a trigger, an optional condition, actions (`describe rules`).

When.description: A rule's trigger (exactly one key; the checker says so).

prop.description: With `prop_enter` / `prop_exit` / a prop's `event`: only this prop, or these (`self` is the one that fired the rule).

Action.description: A rule action: an object with exactly one key.

oneOf.description: `[field, target]`: point an aimed field at a loose prop, an object, `[x, y, z]`, `self` or `null`.

Impulse.description: A shove on a loose prop.

Reset.description: What `reset` puts back: an id, a list of ids, or the props in a zone.

ForceField.description: A force volume on loose props.

toward.description: An aimed field: a loose prop (followed), an object, `[x, y, z]`, or `null` until a rule `aim`s it.

speed.description: An aimed field's pull, m/s (negative pushes away); a number or an expression.

props.description: Only these loose props (an id or a list).

AmmoSupply.description: One ammunition supply for every firearm.

Match.description: The lobby -> countdown -> round -> results flow.

Pickup.description: A weapon or ammo on the map.

labels.description: var -> the name the HUD shows.

pause.description: A line shown on the pause menu (`{var}` placeholders).

UiObjective.description: The objective line: one text, or texts chosen by conditions.

Card.description: A start, pause or end card.

World.description: An endless world: a looping axis and the edges of the others.

Sky.description: A sky dome with a sun.

Clock.description: A day that turns to night.

Museum.description: An endless museum: its collection file, its painted-surface shader, its seed, the first room's theme.

music.description: dawn | day | dusk | night -> a score file.

playlist.description: The player's own music: true, or {title_secs, corner, shuffle}.

AudioMusic.description: A score per time of day.

AudioLayer.description: A score layered in while a variable is above a level.
